Print a VISTA object

Source: R/print.R
print.VISTA.Rd

S3 entry point kept for code that calls print() explicitly (including knitr, which prints rather than auto-displaying). It forwards to the S4 show() method so both routes produce identical output.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'VISTA'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A VISTA object.

...

Ignored.

Value

x, invisibly. Called for its output.

Examples

v <- example_vista()
print(v)
